theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_imp_regular_partition
theorems.statement: ∀ (k N' : ℕ) (H : Euclid k → Euclid N') (B : Set (Euclid k)), MeasurableSet B → ∃ (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid k)) (κ : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ l, MeasurableSet (A l)) ∧ (∀ l, A l ⊆ B) ∧ Pairwise (fun l l' => Disjoint (A l) (A l')) ∧ (∀ l, 0 < κ l) ∧ (∀ l, ∀ a ∈ A l, ∀ a' ∈ A l, κ l * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖H a - H a'‖) ∧ (∀ l, ∀ a ∈ A l, DifferentiableAt ℝ H a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ H a)) ∧ ∀ u ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ H u → Injective (fderiv ℝ H u) → ∃ l, u ∈ A l
